dish.title: Peruvian Ají de Gallina: Creamy Ají Amarillo Chicken with Rice and Potatoes
dish.description: Poached, shredded chicken folded into a silky golden sauce of ají amarillo, onion, garlic, milk-soaked bread, ground walnuts, and Parmesan. Served over white rice with boiled yellow potatoes, halved eggs, and black olives.

recipe_version.title: Peruvian Ají de Gallina: Creamy Ají Amarillo Chicken with Rice and Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Poached, shredded chicken folded into a silky golden sauce of ají amarillo, onion, garlic, milk-soaked bread, ground walnuts, and Parmesan. Served over white rice with boiled yellow potatoes, halved eggs, and black olives.

ingredients.name: yellow onions
ingredients.note: half of 1 for the poach, the rest chopped for the sauce

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp poach, 1 tsp sauce, 1 tsp potatoes

ingredients.name: white sandwich bread
ingredients.display_name: white sandwich bread whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, sugar, oil, and salt only

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut one onion in half; keep one half for the poach and chop the other half with the second onion. Mince the garlic. Tear the crustless bread into the evaporated milk to soak. Rinse the rice and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.body: Put the chicken, 6 cups water, the onion half, and 1 tsp salt in a 4-quart pot. Bring to a bare simmer over medium-high and poach until the chicken reads 165 F, about 18 minutes. Lift out, reserve 1 cup of the broth, and shred the chicken finely with two forks.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat. This runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Boil the potatoes and eggs
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 3-quart saucepan with 6 cups water and 1 tsp salt and boil until tender, about 18 minutes; add the eggs for the last 10 minutes. Drain, cool the eggs under the cold tap, peel, and halve. Halve the potatoes. This runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Blend the base
steps.body: Blend the soaked bread and milk with the walnuts until smooth, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium. Cook the chopped onion until soft and golden, about 8 minutes; add the garlic, ají paste, and cumin for 2 minutes. Stir in the bread-walnut mixture, 1 tsp salt, and enough of the 1 cup reserved broth to loosen, and simmer, stirring, until thick and smooth, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Fold in the shredded chicken and Parmesan and simmer 3 minutes until the sauce coats the chicken.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the ají de gallina over the rice with potato halves and egg halves alongside, and top with olives and parsley.
